UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Registered user profile with full name and original face reference photo.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

fullName.description: Full name entered during account registration.

photoBase64.description: Compressed JPEG Base64 string of the original registered face reference photo.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when account was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

AttendanceRecord.title: AttendanceRecord
AttendanceRecord.description: Permanent daily attendance record keyed by YYYY-MM-DD preventing duplicate IN/OUT and client time tampering.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

userName.description: User full name at the time of attendance.

dateKey.description: Date key in YYYY-MM-DD format matching the document ID.

inTime.description: Immutable server timestamp of daily Check-IN (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

outTime.description: Immutable server timestamp of daily Check-OUT (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

inConfidence.description: Face verification confidence percentage for Check-IN.

outConfidence.description: Face verification confidence percentage for Check-OUT.

faceVerificationStatus.description: Face verification status for accepted attendance.

starred.description: Whether the user starred/favorited this attendance record.

VerificationLog.title: VerificationLog
VerificationLog.description: Immutable audit log of all attendance and face verification attempts (successes and failures).

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

reason.description: Human-readable verification or rule validation message.

/users/{userId}.description: Registered user profile and original face reference photo.

/users/{userId}/attendance/{dateKey}.description: Daily attendance records keyed by YYYY-MM-DD with immutable IN/OUT server timestamps.

/users/{userId}/attendance_logs/{logId}.description: Immutable audit trail of attendance verification attempts.
